feeds.title: Gordon Yates
feeds.description: Gordon Yates is a Wildlife Photographer. He have won several awards in still photography competitions with BBC television, RSPB, Scottish Wildlife and the Scottish Ornithologist Club.

feeds.title: Craig Jones Wildlife Photographer
feeds.description: Craig Jones Wildlife Photographer, captures the beauty of the natural world with his creative and emotional attachment to nature at the very heart of each photo, creating a unique and artistic refection of his time in the field through the meduim of photography.

feeds.title: Peter Moore's Wildlife Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Peter Moore's wildlife blog, created largely to compensate for a failing short-term memory by providing a record of my experiences watching and photographing wildlife. I have been fortunate enough to see over 450 species of bird and 61 species of butterfly in Great Britain, photographing most of these (badly) over the course of the last 15 years.

feeds.title: Kent Dragonflies
feeds.description: A passion for finding and photographing the Dragonflies and Damselflies of Kent, including their nymphs and exuviae.

feeds.title: Carl Bovis Nature Photography
feeds.description: I am an amateur nature photographer from the beautiful county of Somerset in England. My particular passion is birds, and the advent of digital photography has given me the opportunity to capture the birds I see and share them with the world!

feeds.title: Alan Hewitt | Wildlife and Conservation Photographer
feeds.description: I'm a freelance wildlife photographer and writer, photography workshop and safari leader. Found on the Farne Islands, in the Masai Mara and soon, in South Africa. l I hope to share some pictures of what I see and do when I'm out and about doing what I love, taking photographs of wildlife!

feeds.title: Harlequin Pictures | Wildlife Photography
feeds.description: Wildlife photography mainly with photographs of birds mammals, butterflies and dragonmflies etc by Robin Chittenden.

feeds.title: Danny Green Photography Blog
feeds.description: Danny Green's wildlife photography news, travels, workshops, and holidays. Danny is a wildlife photographer based in the United Kingdom who has been photographing the natural world for over thirty years. He travels all over the world in search of images and has a passion for colder climates.

feeds.title: Wildwatcher Eve Blog
feeds.description: I'm a photographer and graphic designer based just outside of Inverness on the beautiful Black Isle. I have always had a huge love for animals, the outdoors and I was always snapping photographs since a very young age. I specialise in wildlife, outdoor and pet portraits, as well as offering wildlife/outdoor photo tours around The Scottish Highlands and guiding for others
